script:
FP=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 200 \
  --check ingress_url eq "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/" --print-header set-cookie | sed -n 's/^oh_app_backend_session=\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p')
test -n "$FP"
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$FP" --expect 200 \
  --check app eq qa-backend
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' \
  --header 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' --expect 200 --check ingress_url eq "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/" \
  --save F29.session-forwarded-proto/session  # bug
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$FP" \
  --header 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' --expect 200 --check app eq qa-backend --save F29.session-forwarded-proto/proxy  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --header 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' --expect 200 --check ingress_url eq "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/" --save F29.session-forwarded-proto/session
